Job Summary

We are seeking a qualified Safety Coordinator to join our team. This position plays a vital role in our operations and offers the opportunity to contribute to a dynamic organization committed to excellence. The ideal candidate will bring a combination of technical expertise, professional skills, and personal qualities that align with our values and culture.

Our Culture

Join a team that values your contributions and invests in your success:

  • Empowerment: We trust our team members to make decisions and take ownership of their work.
  • Recognition: We celebrate achievements and reward excellence through our comprehensive recognition programs.
  • Development: We invest in your growth with training, mentorship, and clear career progression paths.
  • Inclusivity: We embrace diversity and create a welcoming environment for people of all backgrounds.
  • Communication: We maintain open, transparent dialogue at all levels of the organization.
  • Safety First: Your well-being is our priority – we maintain rigorous safety standards and protocols.
  • Community: We give back to the communities we serve through volunteer programs and charitable initiatives.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities, and Key Accountabilities

  • Operate hand tools, power tools, and heavy equipment safely and efficiently, following manufacturer guidelines and OSHA safety regulations
  • Document daily activities including hours worked, materials used, and progress made, reporting information to supervisors for project tracking purposes
  • Collaborate with team members, subcontractors, and supervisors to coordinate activities, troubleshoot issues, and ensure project milestones are met on schedule
  • Protect existing structures and finished surfaces during construction activities, using appropriate covering materials and exercising care when working in occupied spaces
  • Maintain clean and organized work areas, properly dispose of construction debris, and ensure compliance with site housekeeping standards and environmental regulations
  • Perform quality control checks throughout construction process, identifying defects or deviations from specifications and taking corrective action promptly
  • Measure, cut, and install materials precisely using appropriate tools and techniques, verifying measurements and making adjustments as needed for proper fit
  • Respond to changing project conditions and last-minute modifications, adapting work approaches while maintaining quality standards and safety protocols
  • Participate in pre-construction meetings, daily huddles, and project close-out activities, contributing input on scheduling, logistics, and lessons learned
  • Maintain tools and equipment in good working condition through regular cleaning, minor repairs, and proper storage, reporting needed replacements to supervisors
  • Load and unload materials, transport supplies to work areas, and operate material handling equipment including forklifts and pallet jacks when certified
  • Prepare work sites by setting up barriers, signage, and safety equipment, organizing materials and tools, and ensuring proper staging for efficient workflow
  • Read and interpret construction documents including blueprints, specifications, shop drawings, and technical diagrams to execute work accurately
  • Conduct daily safety inspections, identify hazards, report unsafe conditions immediately, and participate in toolbox talks and safety training sessions

Qualifications and Requirements

  • High school diploma required with demonstrated technical aptitude and willingness to learn
  • Extensive experience required including supervisory or leadership responsibilities in similar environment
  • Familiarity with point-of-sale systems, inventory management software, or customer relationship management tools
  • Outstanding customer service orientation with patience, empathy, and commitment to exceeding expectations
  • Strong organizational skills with systematic approach to work and meticulous record-keeping
  • Cultural competency and ability to work effectively with diverse populations and perspectives
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing circumstances
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with keen attention to detail and accuracy
  • Capacity to lift, carry, push, and pull objects weighing up to 50 pounds regularly
  • Stamina to perform physical tasks in varying weather conditions and environmental settings
  • Valid driver's license with clean driving record required for positions involving vehicle operation
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States with required documentation

Physical Demands and Job Site Conditions

  • Outdoor construction environment requiring work in all weather conditions including heat, cold, rain, and varying temperatures
  • Extremely physically demanding work including heavy lifting (50+ pounds regularly), climbing, bending, and sustained physical effort
  • Work at heights on ladders, scaffolding, or elevated platforms requiring comfort with heights and proper safety equipment use
  • Exposure to loud noise from power tools and equipment requiring hearing protection and adherence to OSHA standards
  • Confined spaces, trenches, and challenging work positions requiring flexibility, strength, and specific safety training
  • Requires wearing personal protective equipment including hard hats, safety glasses, gloves, and steel-toed boots at all times
  • Early start times typical (6:00-7:00 AM) with 8-10 hour days; overtime and weekend work common during peak season
  • Exposure to dust, fumes, chemicals, and construction materials requiring respiratory protection in certain situations

Compensation

In accordance with our commitment to pay transparency and equity, we provide the following compensation information for this position. We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining salary including but not limited to: location, relevant education, professional experience, demonstrated skills, and internal equity. Actual compensation will be determined through the interview process and may vary based on these factors.

Starting from $18.00 per hour

Job Summary

We are seeking a qualified Floor Manager to join our team. This position plays a vital role in our operations and offers the opportunity to contribute to a dynamic organization committed to excellence. The ideal candidate will bring a combination of technical expertise, professional skills, and personal qualities that align with our values and culture.

Our Team Values

We believe in creating a workplace where every team member can thrive. Our core values guide everything we do:

  • Integrity: We act with honesty and transparency in all our interactions, building trust with our team and customers.
  • Excellence: We strive for flawless execution and hold ourselves accountable for delivering outstanding results.
  • Collaboration: We work together with respect and inclusion, embracing diverse perspectives to achieve our goals.
  • Innovation: We move with speed and agility, adapting quickly to meet the evolving needs of our industry.
  • Customer Focus: We lead with the customer in mind, ensuring every decision creates value and exceeds expectations.
  • Safety: We maintain a safe and positive environment for our team members and those we serve.
  • Accountability: We take ownership of our work and deliver on our commitments with pride and professionalism.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities, and Key Accountabilities

  • Deliver exceptional customer service by greeting customers warmly, assessing their needs, and providing personalized product recommendations that enhance their shopping experience
  • Train and mentor new team members, sharing product knowledge and best practices to ensure consistent service standards across the team
  • Process customer returns, exchanges, and adjustments professionally and efficiently while adhering to company policies and working to achieve positive resolutions
  • Handle customer complaints and escalate complex issues to management while maintaining composure and professionalism in challenging situations
  • Maintain store cleanliness and organization, including sales floors, fitting rooms, stockrooms, and customer areas, ensuring a safe and welcoming shopping environment at all times
  • Monitor inventory levels, conduct regular stock checks, identify discrepancies, and communicate supply needs to management to prevent out-of-stock situations
  • Support visual merchandising initiatives by setting up seasonal displays, maintaining signage accuracy, and ensuring all marketing materials are current and properly positioned
  • Utilize customer loyalty programs effectively, enrolling new members, explaining benefits, and encouraging repeat business through excellent service
  • Stay informed about current promotions, product features, pricing, and store policies to accurately answer customer questions and maximize sales opportunities
  • Execute merchandising standards by maintaining proper product placement, creating appealing displays, ensuring shelves are fully stocked, and implementing planograms according to company guidelines
  • Maintain compliance with all safety regulations, including proper lifting techniques, hazard awareness, and adherence to emergency procedures
  • Assist with receiving shipments, verifying contents against packing lists, processing incoming merchandise, and organizing stockroom areas for efficient operations
  • Participate in loss prevention efforts by maintaining awareness of theft indicators, following security protocols, and reporting suspicious activities to management
  • Operate point-of-sale (POS) systems with accuracy, processing cash, credit, and mobile payments while maintaining proper cash handling procedures and balancing registers at shift end

Qualifications and Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in related field preferred
  • 1-2 years of relevant experience preferred; will train motivated candidates with strong foundational skills
  • Strong computer skills including data entry, file management, and basic troubleshooting capabilities
  • Experience with industry-specific software systems and demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly
  • Results-driven mindset with history of meeting or exceeding performance goals and targets
  • Outstanding customer service orientation with patience, empathy, and commitment to exceeding expectations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with keen attention to detail and accuracy
  • Cultural competency and ability to work effectively with diverse populations and perspectives
  • Leadership capabilities with experience mentoring, training, or supervising others
  • Exceptional communication skills with ability to convey complex information clearly to diverse audiences
  • Collaborative team player who also works effectively independently with minimal supervision
  • Ability to stand, walk, and remain mobile for extended periods during scheduled shifts
  • Ability to pass background check, drug screening, and other pre-employment requirements
  • Professional references from previous supervisors or colleagues who can attest to qualifications
  • Availability to work flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed

Environmental Job Conditions

  • Most time is spent standing and walking on hard surfaces throughout assigned shift, requiring physical stamina and comfortable footwear
  • Frequent bending, stooping, reaching, kneeling, and crouching to stock shelves, assist customers, and maintain displays at various heights
  • Regular lifting and carrying of merchandise weighing up to 30 pounds; occasional team lifts for items exceeding 50 pounds with proper technique
  • Indoor climate-controlled environment with occasional exposure to storage areas that may be warmer or cooler than sales floor
  • May be exposed to cleaning chemicals and require use of personal protective equipment when handling certain products
  • Fast-paced environment with periods of high customer volume requiring sustained energy and focus
  • Requires manual dexterity for operating cash registers, scanners, and other point-of-sale equipment
